en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Renaissance Revival opera house on a busy city street corner. The multi‑story building has arched windows, elaborate stonework, and a prominent mansard roof. In front and alongside run wide streets filled with pedestrians, horse‑drawn vehicles or carriages, early automobiles, and several electric trams. At the top right of the image is a printed caption identifying the scene.
